t: City of the Damned: New Orleans
verdict: Three princes, one city, and enough NPC knives to keep a campaign moving for a year.
body: Vidal, Savoy and Cimitière are a perfect three-body problem — I have not had to invent a single faction. The book is thin on the mortal city, which is where my table spends most of its time, so I supplement heavily with the actual 1990 record.
